news.headline: Delcath Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:DCTH) Given Consensus Rating of "Moderate Buy" by Brokerages
news.summary: Seven brokerages covering Delcath now carry an average "Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of about $23.17, roughly double the recent share price. Recent moves include BTIG raising its target to $21 from $17 and Wall Street Zen upgrading the stock from Hold to Buy.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Hits New 52-Week High as Zacks Upgrades Stock to Strong-Buy
news.summary: Zacks Research upgraded DCTH from Hold to Strong-Buy following the Q2 beat and raised guidance, and shares traded as high as roughly $17.42, a new 52-week high. The move extended the post-earnings rally that began after the August 6 results.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Presents at Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Delcath management presented a corporate update to investors in Boston, reiterating HEPZATO KIT commercial momentum and center-expansion plans.

news.headline: H.C. Wainwright Raises Delcath Price Target to $32 from $30
news.summary: H.C. Wainwright reiterated its Buy rating and lifted its price target to $32, citing HEPZATO demand momentum; several other brokerages also raised targets after the Q2 print.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results, Raises Full-Year Guidance
news.summary: Delcath reported Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1 million, up 20% year-over-year (HEPZATO KIT revenue $27.1 million, up ~30% in volume), with 90% gross margin and net income of $2.7 million. Management raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104-108 million and said it plans to reach 37 active HEPZATO treatment centers by year-end, up from 31.

news.headline: New Data at ESMO Breast Cancer 2026 Show 60% Hepatic Response Rate with Percutaneous Hepatic Perfusion
news.summary: Independent investigators presented retrospective data at ESMO Breast Cancer 2026 showing a 60% hepatic partial response rate using melphalan percutaneous hepatic perfusion in heavily pretreated liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer patients, supporting the ongoing Phase 2 breast cancer program.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Delcath's next scheduled quarterly results release; date not yet formally announced.

catalysts.label: Additional HEPZATO treatment center activations
catalysts.detail: Company plans to activate roughly six more HEPZATO KIT treatment centers by year-end 2026, reaching about 37 active centers (up from 31 as of Q2 2026), to support raised FY2026 volume guidance.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 mCRC hepatic-PFS readout
catalysts.detail: Hepatic progression-free survival data expected from the Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO in liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer, combined with standard of care; overall survival data expected later in 2028.

pulse: Delcath continues to execute on strong commercial momentum for HEPZATO KIT, with Q2 2026 revenue up 20% year-over-year, raised FY2026 guidance to $104-108 million, and plans to expand to 37 active treatment centers by year-end. Shares hit fresh 52-week highs above $17 in mid-August on a wave of analyst upgrades and price-target increases (Zacks to Strong-Buy, H.C. Wainwright to $32, BTIG to $21), and as of late August the stock carries a consensus "Moderate Buy" rating with an average target near $23. No major new catalysts or setbacks have emerged since the mid-August highs; the stock is consolidating gains from the Q2 beat and ESMO breast cancer data while the market awaits further center activations and the next quarterly print (~November).
